execute:
  eval: true
  echo: false
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
---

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Data: https://ourworldindata.org/economic-inequality
income <- readr::read_csv("2025/data/income-share-of-the-richest-1.csv")
plot_data <- income |>
  dplyr::filter(Year == 2023) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(Country, "(WID)", negate = TRUE),
    Country != "World"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Country = stringr::str_remove(Country, " \\(country\\)")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Continent = countrycode::countrycode(
      sourcevar = Country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "continent"
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::drop_na() |> 
  dplyr::rename(
    Income = `Income share of the richest 1% (before tax) (World Inequality Database)`)
ojs_define(plot_data = plot_data)
```

```{ojs}
data = transpose(plot_data)
```


```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.frame(),
    Plot.rectY(data, Plot.binX({y: "count"}, {x: "Income", stroke: "black", fy: "Continent", fill: "Continent",
      sort: {y: "x", fy: "x", reduce: "median", reverse: true}})),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ],
  // Styling
  height: 800,
  width: 800,
  marginRight: 10,
  marginLeft: 50,
  y: {grid: true},
  fy: {label: "", tickRotate: -90},
  color: {
    scheme: "oranges",
    domain: ["Europe", "Oceania", "Africa", "Americas", "Asia"]
  },
  title: "The share of income received by the richest 1% of the population in 2023.",
  subtitle: "Income is measured before payment of taxes and non-pension benefits but after the payment of public and private pensions.",
  caption: "Data: World Inequality Database (WID). Processed by Our World in Data.",
})
```
